chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
“The father does not descend into the grave of his child, while the child descends into the grave of his father.”

key_terms.الْوَلَدُ: the child; offspring in relation to the parent
key_terms.اَلْوَالِدُ: the father; the parent in relation to the child
key_terms.قَبْرِ: grave; the burial place of the deceased
key_terms.يَنْزِلُ: descends; enters down into the grave

ai.seo_question: Who may descend into the grave during burial according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a funeral-related ruling concerning who should descend into the grave during burial. It distinguishes between the father and the child in relation to one another, indicating a specific etiquette or legal practice in burial rites.
